name: donut-chart
title: Donut Chart
description: A half-donut gauge with rounded, separated segments, an optional total header, the featured segment in the centre, and a one-row legend. Uses namespace exports: DonutChart.Root.

docs.lead: Segments along a half-donut. The featured segment's value and label fill the centre; pass a total to show a figure above the arc.
docs.usage:
import * as DonutChart from "@/components/ui/donut-chart"

<DonutChart.Root
  items={[{ label: "Category A", value: 10 }, { label: "Category B", value: 55 }]}
  highlighted="Category B"
  total={{ label: "Total", value: 65 }}
  unit="Items"
/>

examples.title: Default
examples.description: One segment per item, with the highlighted one's value and label in the centre. Past two segments the colours continue the series ramp. Keep labels short, since the legend is one row.

examples.title: With total
examples.description: Pass total and the header shows above the arc. Pass unit and hovering a segment names what it counts.
examples.code:
<DonutChart.Root
  items={items}
  highlighted="Category B"
  total={{ label: "Total", value: 65 }}
  unit="Items"
/>

examples.title: With short labels
examples.description: Give an item a shortLabel when its full name won't fit the one-row legend. The legend and centre show the short label; hovering a segment shows the full one.
examples.code:
<DonutChart.Root
  items={[
    { label: "Category Alpha (CA)", shortLabel: "CA", value: 18 },
    { label: "Category Beta (CB)", shortLabel: "CB", value: 24 },
    { label: "Category Gamma (CG)", shortLabel: "CG", value: 8 },
  ]}
  highlighted="Category Beta (CB)"
/>

api.name: DonutChart.Root
api.description: The optional header, the arc and the legend. Sized for a 352px card.

props.name: items
props.type: { label: string; shortLabel?: string; value: number; color?: string }[]
props.description: Segments along the arc, left to right. shortLabel, when given, replaces label in the legend and centre; the tooltip keeps label

props.name: highlighted
props.description: Label of the segment to feature, matched against label, not shortLabel. Omitted or null leaves the centre bare

props.name: total
props.description: A caption over a figure above the arc. Shown only when passed

props.name: unit
props.description: What the values count, beside the value in the tooltip
